name: Amatsuka Nanana
source: A net idol whose smile and gesture attract others, gaining her the name Tenshi (which means Angel, also a different pronunciation of her last name Amatsuka). While she's a natural when it comes to outward appearance, she's not very good at studying, singing and anything that requires extensive body movement.
